ResourceHeader.ResourceName: IBEX High Energy Neutral Atom Imager (Hi) Data Release 18, Compton-Getting corrected, Survival Probability corrected, OMNI Solar Ecliptic ENA Maps, Level H3, fourteen-year combined Data

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial release of metadata, ADAPT generated, LFB
Curated and checked for SPASE 2.7.2 structural and semantic consistency, OK

ResourceHeader.Description: IBEX-Hi Release 18 fourteen-year combined hydrogen energetic neutral atom (ENA) maps from omnidirectional observations, with documented coverage from 2008-12-25 through 2022-12-26. The product contains one combined map per energy channel, not a series of six-month maps. Compton-Getting correction accounts for spacecraft motion; survival-probability correction accounts for ENA losses and scales fluxes from near 1 AU to approximately 100 AU. Maps use a 60 by 30 Solar Ecliptic grid at six-degree spacing, with West_Longitude and Latitude as the first and second array dimensions. Channels 2-6 have nominal energies of 0.71, 1.11, 1.74, 2.73, and 4.29 keV; Ener2-Ener6 provide the mapped energies for individual pixels. Parameters include differential flux, flux variance, signal-to-noise ratio, total counts, total exposure time, and samples per pixel averaged over the measurement interval, together with time, map, coordinate, and orbit support variables. The *_plasma variables provide virtual CDAWeb X/Y alternate views. The CDAWeb ProductKey is IBEX_H3_ENA_HI_R18_CG_SP_OMNI_14YR.
ResourceHeader.Acknowledgement: Please acknowledge the IBEX Mission Principal Investigator, Dr. David J. McComas of Princeton University. The IBEX Release 18 data are archived as fully citable data. Please consult IBEX team publications and personnel for further details on production, processing, and usage of these data.
